brief: Total operating ethylene capacity in Southeast Asia

sections.title: Operating Ethylene Supply Base in Southeast Asia
questions: Which ethylene plants are currently operating in Southeast Asia?
What is the nameplate capacity of each operating ethylene plant in the region?
What is the total operating ethylene capacity in Southeast Asia, based on publicly confirmed figures?
sections.tool_rationale: The plant register provides a filterable list of operating ethylene plants in Southeast Asia and their capacities; documents are needed to clarify or supplement where capacity is not publicly confirmed or to address any register limitations.
sections.unanswerable_if: If the register does not contain capacity figures for operating ethylene plants in Southeast Asia, or if a significant portion of capacity is not publicly confirmed and cannot be supplemented from documents.

sections.title: Gaps and Limitations in Capacity Data
questions: Are there any operating ethylene plants in Southeast Asia for which capacity is not publicly confirmed?
What are the limitations or gaps in the available capacity data, and how do they affect the total?
sections.tool_rationale: Describing the corpus and searching documents identifies plants with unconfirmed capacity and clarifies the scope and limitations of the available data.
sections.unanswerable_if: If there is no indication in the register or documents of any gaps or limitations in capacity data for operating ethylene plants in Southeast Asia.

excluded.topic: Aggregate regional capacity total from industry association bulletins
excluded.reason: ASEAN Petrochemical Monitor explicitly does not publish aggregate regional capacity totals in its bulletins.
